tool_signatures.name: todoist_create_project
tool_signatures.description:
Create a new project in Todoist.

Color options: berry_red, red, orange, yellow, olive_green, lime_green, green,
mint_green, teal, sky_blue, light_blue, blue, grape, violet, lavender,
magenta, salmon, charcoal, grey, taupe.

tool_signatures.name: todoist_move_project
tool_signatures.description:
Move a project under a different parent project, or back to the workspace root.

Pass parent_id to nest the project as a sub-project of another. Omit parent_id (or pass
null explicitly) to move the project to the workspace root.

Uses the Todoist Sync API

project_id.description: ID of the project to move

parent_id.description: Target parent project ID. Omit or pass null to move the project to the workspace root.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Target parent project ID. Omit or pass null to move the project to the workspace root.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: ID of the project to move
